description:
Returns a page of issue type metadata for a specified project. Use the information to populate the requests in [ Create issue](#api-rest-api-3-issue-post) and [Create issues](#api-rest-api-3-issue-bulk-post).

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Create issues* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) in the requested projects.

parameters.description: The ID or key of the project.
parameters.name: projectIdOrKey

parameters.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: maxResults

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

summary: Get create metadata issue types for a project
